heroText: Flåm works best as a base in Norway when you anchor days around Flam Railway, Aurlandsfjord and Naeroyfjord cruises. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Flåm International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: In 1670, Flåm Church was built in the village, replacing an older stave church.

history.label: 1800s
history.text: The original Fretheim Hotel, established in the late 1800s, expanded to welcome more international guests, offering a comfortable stay amid the wild nature.
In 1908, the Norwegian Parliament approved the construction of the Flåm Line railway, though the funds to construct the railway were not allocated until 1923.
In 1942, regular operation of steam-powered trains started on the Flåm Line.

history.label: 1960s
history.text: By the 1960s, cruise ships had begun anchoring in the fjord (they were too large to dock, so passengers would take smaller boats ashore).

history.label: 1980s
history.text: The Norway in a Nutshell tour – a popular packaged day-trip including the Flåm Railway and fjord ferry – started bringing many visitors to Flåm starting in the 1980s and onward.
